about: The Mars Genesis pair run the landing page replays: Aria Chen against Dietrich Voss, seed 950, 6 turns of 8 years from Year 2035, 30 people, saved on 18 November 2026 (session 694fff92-b3b1-4329-9fc6-247eed0ffd48, 226 events, completed 18:14 UTC), as GET /sessions/<id>/replay served it. Kept, in the order they were sent: the leaders and their HEXACO profiles, the scenario, each turn's start (its event title, a director's placeholder title included), decision, outcome class, forged tools with the judge's verdict and confidence, each leader's systems snapshot (each person's id, name, department, rank, whether alive, Mars-born and featured), each turn's end with the run's running cost, the verdict and each leader's seed. The dashboard's build writes the page's digest from this file (src/dashboard/src/landing/replayDigest.ts).
